thread:
maria: FYI prod perf spike after the 11:13 deploy (commit abc123). Short-seq p50/p95 up ~2x, compile-queue backlog climbed ~5x. Alert board: https://perf.redwood/boards/882

alex: On it. Any traces or profiles yet?

maria: Traces + profile: https://perf.redwood/trace/12345. Quick summary: excessive kernel compile invocations for small-batch (batch=1) requests. KV cache hit rates look unchanged. Autotuner logs show a tiebreak pick to `kernel_v2_q4` where previously we used `kernel_v1_q4`.

shiv: @alex @maria running a bisect now. CI perf job also showed the same regression: https://ci.redwood/pipeline/7890

deploy-bot: Deploy started: merge abc123 -> main at 1999129860

shiv: Bisect narrowed the regression to commit def456 (autotune: change kernel_order heuristic). Reproducer (local): `scripts/repro_shortseq.sh --model gpt-small --batch 1`

luke: If autotune chose v2 because of a tiny microbenchmark delta, it shouldn't force that pick for short sequences. Current heuristic has no runtime guard for compile-queue or seq-length. Proposal: revert heuristic or add fallback when `compile_queue > 50` or `seq_len < 64`.

alex: Can we feature-flag the heuristic? Revert if quick is faster.

maria: Impact estimate: ~20% user traffic is short-seq; p50 ~1.9x and we risk SLA breaches. Revert seems safest to keep latency SLAs.

shiv: Opened revert PR: #4321 (revert commit def456). Ran `make perf-local` and CI perf jobs pass locally. Plan: revert -> canary in prod -> promote.

oncall-amber: Rolling revert now, please ping when done. Pager noise from the alert is high.

deploy-bot: Revert PR #4321 merged at 1999130001. Starting canary rollout (hosts: canary-3).

perf-ci-bot: Perf comparison (pre-merge vs post-revert) for canary: p50 back to baseline on canary hosts. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood/compare/4321

maria: :thumbsup: thanks. Follow-ups: add a regression test under `ci/perf/shortseq` that repros this scenario and add a runtime fallback in the autotuner so picks degrade to `kernel_v1_q4` when compile backlog or small seqs detected.

shiv: Filing follow-up ticket PERF-1978 with repro, logs, and heuristic patch proposal. Also enabling a temporary flag: `autotune.fallback_on_compile_backlog=true` for the next deploy.

luke: Also adding a guard in the rollout orchestrator: do not switch kernel picks if compile queue length >= 100.

alex: I'll own the CI perf test. Will link the PR here when ready.

maria: Closing alert, monitoring for 30m before marking resolved.

deploy-bot: Canary finished, promoted to prod at 1999130578

maria: Resolved at 1999130580 — thanks everyone.
